name: gtmos-mcp
description: Deterministic CRM audit for HubSpot: integrity score, duplicate clusters, stalled revenue, GTM ops health and a policy-gated proposal queue. Runs locally with your own token and never writes to the CRM.

hubspot_token.title: HubSpot private-app token
hubspot_token.description: Read-only scopes are enough (crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.deals.read). Leave empty to audit JSON exports only.

allowed_dir.title: Allowed directory
allowed_dir.description: The only folder the tools may read exports from and write reports to. Leave empty for no restriction.
